name: design-studio
description: Two independent plugins: design-studio, a multi-agent UI/UX design studio built on the impeccable skill, and knowledge-vault, which keeps one Obsidian vault per product up to date with its code.

plugins.name: design-studio
plugins.description: Interviewed brief, three divergent directions judged from rendered pixels, capped refinement with scripted checks.

plugins.name: knowledge-vault
plugins.description: One Obsidian vault per product in its own private git repository: documentation passes after functionality changes reach the main branch, and mechanical vault sync between machines.
